name: opt_import_base.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((ImpBase (mk-ImpBase (x Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-ImpBase (sel-ImpBase ImpBase))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-ImpBase ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-ImpBase (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-ImpBase ((this Ref)) ImpBase
  (sel-ImpBase (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-ImpBase ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-ImpBase this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ------------------------------
;   Getters for class ImpBase:
; ------------------------------

; --- getters for ImpBase.x: ---

(define-fun ImpBase!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-ImpBase this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; --------------------------------
;   Invariant for class ImpBase:
; --------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-ImpBase ImpBase)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun ImpBase.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (ImpBase!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (ImpBase.inv1 1) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun ImpBase.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (ImpBase!x this) 50)
)

(assert (! (ImpBase.inv2 1) :named _xkassert1))




; ================================
; === Optimization Objectives: ===
; ================================

(maximize (let ((this 1)) (ImpBase!x this)))

; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-ImpBase const-1-ImpBase))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-ImpBase () ImpBase
  (mk-ImpBase 50))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-ImpBase (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (<= (x (sel-ImpBase (select heap 1))) 50))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null) 1 (lift-ImpBase (mk-ImpBase 50))))
